title: EV Powertrain & Battery Engineer
description: Designs electric motor drive units, battery management systems (BMS), and power electronics for Malaysia's national EV automotive transition.
sdg_justification: Supports clean mobility transition and sustainable automotive manufacturing (SDG 7 & 9).
qualification_note: B.Eng in Electrical, Mechanical, or Automotive Engineering registered with BEM.

title: Data Center Facilities Engineer
description: Manages mission-critical power distribution, liquid cooling infrastructure, and uptime operations for hyperscale data centers in Johor and Cyberjaya.
sdg_justification: Ensures energy-efficient operations for critical digital infrastructure (SDG 9 & 12).
qualification_note: Certified Data Center Professional (CDCP) or BEM registered Engineer preferred.

title: AI Governance & Ethics Officer
description: Evaluates algorithmic bias, data privacy, and ethical compliance for AI system deployments aligned with MOSTI AI Ethics Guidelines.
sdg_justification: Ensures responsible and transparent technological innovation (SDG 9 & 16).
qualification_note: Background in Data Governance, Law, Computer Science, or Information Systems.

title: DevOps & Site Reliability Engineer
description: Automates CI/CD pipelines, container orchestration (Kubernetes), and system reliability for digital banks and enterprise software.
sdg_justification: Strengthens software infrastructure resilience for digital services (SDG 9).
qualification_note: Kubernetes CKA/CKAD or Docker/AWS certifications highly valued.

title: Full-Stack Web & Applications Developer
description: Engineers scalable front-end and back-end web applications using modern web frameworks for local enterprise and fintech ecosystems.
sdg_justification: Drives digital economy growth and tech enterprise capabilities (SDG 8 & 9).
qualification_note: Diploma/Degree in Computer Science or Software Engineering.

title: Enterprise Database & Data Engineer
description: Designs relational and NoSQL database architecture, ETL pipelines, and performance tuning for regional shared service centers.
sdg_justification: Optimizes enterprise data infrastructure across critical economic sectors (SDG 9).
qualification_note: Oracle, PostgreSQL, or SQL Server certifications advantageous.

title: 5G & Telecommunications Network Engineer
description: Deploys and maintains 5G RAN, fiber backhaul, and enterprise private networks supporting Digital Nasional Berhad (DNB) infrastructure.
sdg_justification: Expands high-speed connectivity essential for digital transformation (SDG 9).
qualification_note: CCNA/CCNP or vendor specific 5G network certifications preferred.

title: Wafer Fabrication Process Engineer
description: Controls chemical vapor deposition, photolithography, and yield optimization in semiconductor wafer foundries in Penang and Kulim.
sdg_justification: Advances high-value semiconductor manufacturing capabilities under NIMP 2030 (SDG 9).
qualification_note: Degree in Chemical, Material Science, Microelectronics, or Physics.

title: Advanced Semiconductor Packaging Engineer
description: Develops 2.5D/3D chiplet packaging, wire bonding, and thermal management for OSAT semiconductor packaging houses.
sdg_justification: Strengthens Malaysia's global OSAT backend semiconductor footprint (SDG 9).
qualification_note: B.Eng in Mechanical, Materials, or Electronics Engineering.

title: Smart Factory & Robotics Technician
description: Maintains, calibrates, and troubleshoots robotic arms, AGVs, and automated conveyor systems in automated manufacturing plants.
sdg_justification: Sustains smart factory operations and skilled TVET employment growth (SDG 8 & 9).
qualification_note: Malaysian Skills Certificate (SKM Level 3/4/5) or Diploma in Industrial Automation.

title: Chemical & Oleochemical Process Engineer
description: Optimizes chemical reactions and palm oil downstream refining processes in oleochemical complexes and refineries.
sdg_justification: Drives sustainable bio-based manufacturing and chemical export value (SDG 9 & 12).
qualification_note: Degree in Chemical Engineering registered with BEM.

title: CNC Precision Tooling Engineer
description: Programs multi-axis CNC machines and designs precision molds and dies for aerospace component manufacturing and tooling export.
sdg_justification: Advances high-precision engineering manufacturing capabilities (SDG 9).
qualification_note: Diploma/Degree in Mechanical, Manufacturing, or Precision Engineering.

title: Digital Tax & LHDN e-Invoicing Consultant
description: Advises corporate clients on ERP system API integrations to comply with LHDN MyInvois mandatory e-invoicing standards.
sdg_justification: Modernizes national tax administration and corporate reporting transparency (SDG 8 & 16).
qualification_note: MIA / CTIM membership or ERP implementation background (SAP, Oracle, Navision).

title: Enterprise Risk & Quantitative Analyst
description: Builds credit, market, and operational risk models for financial institutions under Bank Negara Malaysia stress-testing requirements.
sdg_justification: Ensures stability and resilience in the national banking sector (SDG 8 & 16).
qualification_note: Degree in Actuarial Science, Financial Mathematics, or Statistics.

title: Global Procurement & Sourcing Specialist
description: Manages vendor contracts, raw material sourcing, and supplier ESG compliance for multinational shared services and manufacturers.
sdg_justification: Promotes fair trade practices and supply chain sustainability (SDG 8 & 12).
qualification_note: CIPS certification or Degree in Supply Chain / Business Management.

title: Actuarial Valuation Specialist
description: Performs liability valuations, insurance product pricing, and solvency capital calculations for life and general insurance/takaful operators.
sdg_justification: Sustains national financial security and risk management mechanisms (SDG 8).
qualification_note: Progress towards SOA, IFoA, or ASM professional actuarial examinations.

title: Corporate Governance & AML/CFT Officer
description: Monitors Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Countering Financing of Terrorism (CFT) compliance under Bank Negara and SC guidelines.
sdg_justification: Upholds financial institution integrity and fights illicit financial flows (SDG 16).
qualification_note: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist (CAMS) credential preferred.

title: Bioprocess & Biopharmaceutical Engineer
description: Scales fermentation, cell culture, and purification processes for vaccine and biopharmaceutical production under National Biotechnology Policy 2.0.
sdg_justification: Enhances domestic biomanufacturing self-reliance and healthcare innovation (SDG 3 & 9).
qualification_note: Degree in Bioprocess Engineering, Biotechnology, or Chemical Engineering.

title: Medical Device Quality Assurance Engineer
description: Ensures ISO 13485 quality system compliance and biocompatibility testing for medical glove, catheter, and surgical instrument manufacturing.
sdg_justification: Guarantees medical equipment quality standards for local and export healthcare markets (SDG 3 & 9).
qualification_note: Knowledge of Medical Device Authority (MDA) regulations required.

title: Industrial & Clinical Pharmacist
description: Oversees drug formulations, batch release, and Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) compliance in pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities.
sdg_justification: Protects public health by verifying pharmaceutical product quality and safety (SDG 3).
qualification_note: Registered Pharmacist with the Pharmacy Board of Malaysia (Lembaga Farmasi Malaysia).

title: Environmental Impact Assessment Consultant
description: Conducts EIA studies, biodiversity assessments, and effluent monitoring reports for development projects approved by the Department of Environment.
sdg_justification: Protects terrestrial ecosystems and natural habitats from industrial encroachment (SDG 12 & 15).
qualification_note: Registered EIA Consultant with DOE (Jabatan Alam Sekitar) Malaysia.

title: Hydrogen Energy & Fuel Cell Engineer
description: Designs green hydrogen electrolyzers, fuel cell storage, and transport infrastructure for Sarawak's H2 export projects under NETR.
sdg_justification: Pioneers zero-emission fuel technologies for regional energy exports (SDG 7 & 13).
qualification_note: B.Eng in Chemical, Mechanical, or Energy Engineering.

title: Biomass & Bioenergy Specialist
description: Converts oil palm empty fruit bunches (EFB) and agricultural waste into biogas, pellets, and bio-coal power generation.
sdg_justification: Promotes circular economy solutions for Malaysia's palm oil sector (SDG 7 & 12).
qualification_note: Degree in Bioenergy, Agricultural Engineering, or Chemical Engineering.

title: Renewable Grid Integration Engineer
description: Models grid stability, BESS (Battery Energy Storage Systems), and high-voltage interconnectors for Tenaga Nasional Berhad (TNB).
sdg_justification: Modernizes grid infrastructure to absorb higher variable renewable energy load (SDG 7 & 9).
qualification_note: Electrical Engineering Degree registered with BEM.

title: Animation & VFX Pipeline Technical Director
description: Develops custom Python scripts, Maya/Unreal plugins, and rendering pipelines for local animation and visual effects studios.
sdg_justification: Boosts technical productivity for high-export digital content industries (SDG 8 & 9).
qualification_note: Strong Python/C++ skills and experience with CG production software.

title: Digital Banking & Fintech Product Manager
description: Leads product feature roadmaps, e-KYC integration, and mobile UX design for Bank Negara licensed digital banking applications.
sdg_justification: Drives financial inclusion for unbanked and underbanked populations (SDG 8 & 9).
qualification_note: Agile/Scrum certifications (PSPO/CSPO) highly preferred.

title: E-Commerce Strategy & Operations Specialist
description: Manages multi-channel storefront operations, digital performance marketing, and fulfillment strategy for regional e-commerce brands.
sdg_justification: Facilitates SME digitisation and cross-border e-commerce growth (SDG 8).
qualification_note: Hands-on experience with Shopee, Lazada, TikTok Shop enterprise seller tools.

title: Mega Infrastructure Civil Engineer
description: Oversees structural design, tunneling, and viaduct construction for railway (ECRL, MRT3) and highway mega infrastructure.
sdg_justification: Expands resilient public transit infrastructure connecting urban and rural corridors (SDG 9 & 11).
qualification_note: B.Eng in Civil Engineering with BEM Graduate/Professional Engineer registration.

title: Geotechnical & Slope Safety Engineer
description: Performs soil mechanics analysis, slope stabilization, and foundation engineering under Jabatan Kerja Raya (JKR) safety guidelines.
sdg_justification: Prevents landslide disasters and ensures infrastructure resilience in hilly terrains (SDG 9 & 11).
qualification_note: Civil/Geotechnical Engineering degree registered with BEM.

title: External Halal Auditor & Standards Specialist
description: Conducts third-party Halal supply chain audits and advisory services for multinational food and cosmetics exporters seeking JAKIM certification.
sdg_justification: Sustains international compliance and export trade confidence in Halal goods (SDG 8 & 12).
qualification_note: Certified Halal Auditor recognized by the Halal Professional Board (HPB, JAKIM).

title: Industrial TVET Technical Instructor
description: Delivers practical technical training and VTO (Vocational Trainer Officer) modules for SKM diploma students at ILP/IKTBN institutes.
sdg_justification: Upskills national youth labor force under the National TVET Policy (SDG 4 & 8).
qualification_note: Vocational Trainer Officer (VTO) certification and SKM Level 4/5 qualification.

title: Maritime Port & Shipping Operations Planner
description: Schedules container vessel berths, yard crane movements, and intermodal transport connections at Port Klang and Port of Tanjung Pelepas (PTP).
sdg_justification: Optimizes efficiency for major international shipping lanes in the Malacca Strait (SDG 9 & 14).
qualification_note: Degree in Maritime Studies, Logistics, or Supply Chain Management.
